conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.message: What kind of feedback would be most helpful to look for?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Look for feedback on clarity, pacing, body language, and how well you engaged the audience. Specific suggestions for improvement are always more helpful than general praise or criticism.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For instance, feedback like "Your introduction was a bit rushed" or "Try making more eye contact with the back row" provides actionable insights. Contrast this with general comments such as "That was good" or "You need to improve."
